 Here’s how much Medicare Part B premiums are increasing in 2027 
 Open enrollment is underway and major changes are coming to Medicare plan next year. (Source: CNN) By Amanda Alvarado Published : Nov. 18, 2026 at 7:24 AM CST | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google (Gray News) - Medicare Part B premiums are increasing next year. 
 The standard monthly premium for Medicare Part B enrollees will be $209.40 for 2027, according to the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services .
 That is a $6.50 increase from $202.90 this year.
 The annual deductible for Medicare Part B beneficiaries will be $292 in 2027. The current deductible is $283.
 The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services said the increases in the 2027 Part B standard premium and deductible are because of projected increases in health care spending.
